Does Brad Pitt die in Sleepers?

He plays Michael Sullivan.

Want to guess first?

Revealing shows the answer, the scene, and a clip if we have one.

No. Throws the case, quits, and becomes a carpenter in England.

Michael, one of four Hell's Kitchen boys abused at a juvenile home, grows up to be an assistant DA who deliberately sabotages his own prosecution of his friends for killing guard Nokes, exposing the other abusers. The epilogue says Michael quits the DA's office, moves to the English countryside and becomes a carpenter. His friends John and Tommy die young; Michael doesn't.
